title: Reciprocal Polynomials with Zeros on the Unit Circle and Derivatives of Chebyshev Polynomials of the Second Kind
summary: In this article, we consider the reciprocal antisymmetric polynomial \[P(z) = \sum_{j = 0}^{s}(-1)^jγ_j\left(z^j - z^{N + s + 1 - j}\right), \ γ_0 = 1.\] It is shown that if all the zeros of $P(z)$ are located on the unit circle, that $\displaystyle\left|γ_j\right| \leq {s \choose j}\left({N + s + 1 \choose j}\right)^{-1}$, $j = 1,\ldots,s$; moreover, these estimates cannot be improved in the general case.
